OTHER ITEMS:

     a)     ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming,
           various tracts of land completely surrounded by current City limits situate in
           western and southern Cheyenne, generally located east of I-25, south of the
           intersection of Westland Road and Missile Drive, north of West and East Allison
           Road, and east of and adjacent to North College Drive. (POSTPONED FROM
           MARCH 9, 2026)

ACTION:

     b)    ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City
           of Cheyenne, establishing the zoning classifications of AG – Agricultural, MR –
           Medium- Density Residential, CB – Community Business, and LI – Light
           Industrial, for land annexed to the City of Cheyenne generally located east of I-25,
           south of the intersection of Westland Road and Missile Drive, north of West and
           East Allison Road, and east of and adjacent to North College Drive. (POSTPONED
           FROM MARCH 9, 2026)
